message: 料理の鉄刃

name: Pasta
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting, nya~! The food is ready, nya」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
A few minutes after lunch break started, Pasta showed up at the Student Council room without any warning.
With the Holy Night Festival coming up, we in the Student Council had planned to have a quick meeting while eating lunch.
We also asked Shio-chan to sit in so we could get a regular student's perspective.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Lero~n, lick, lick ♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte-san, that's not how you eat vegetable sticks」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But the dressing coated on the veggies tastes way better. Chupappa~\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're not even eating the actual veggies, man」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, is that seriously Misa's lunch again? How do you even get full off that?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I just have a small appetite」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, I get it! The dressing has tons of calories packed into it, right!」

name: Misa
message: 「Gasp!?」

name: Shio
message: 「A-Aneue? I understand the emotional shock, but we have a guest, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「E-Everyone, this is Pasta. You remember him, right?」

name: Pasta
message: 「You're keeping a bunch like this in line, nya? Must be rough, nya...」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't just barge in out of nowhere and call us 'a bunch like this'!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, the Student Council has to handle emergencies for anyone connected to the academy」

name: Synn
message: 「What's going on today, Pasta?」

name: Pasta
message: 「You'll hear Pasta out, nya? Even if it's just boss of a tiny monkey mountain, you're still a man who stands above humans, nya」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's not a compliment at all, dude」

name: Pasta
message: 「For causing you guys all kinds of trouble... I'm really sowwy, nya」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh-huh, you mean 'sorry,' right?」

name: Pasta
message: 「As a token of apology, I prepared a special lunch, nya. Pasta put all his skill into cooking it, nya」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Lies. You're trying to trick us! The \{pork|\s12} wholesaler won't let that fly!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Th-That's mean, way too mean, nya! Even though you're an angel, you don't have a trusting heart, nya.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am not an angel, so it is fine!」

name: Misa
message: 「Special lunch...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, so you *are* hungry after all, Misa.」

name: Shio
message: 「Lady Nanaka, some things are best left unsaid.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I am not hungry! My stomach is completely full! It's all plump and jiggly, and I'm getting chubby!」

name: Ria
message: 「M-Misa-chan, you're saying some pretty wild things.」

name: Misa
message: 「Anyway, I wouldn't touch Pasta's home cooking if you paid me!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Did someone just click their tongue--」

name: Pasta
message: 「*Sniff*, *sniffle*, *hic*! Pasta, Pasta... just wanted everyone to be happy, so I worked so hard cooking... *waaaah*!」
Pasta clings to me and bursts into tears.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uh-oh, you made her cry. Don't look at me.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Even though I got up around 3 in the morning to start prepping... *sob, sob, sob*.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, you...」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey, don't cry, Pasta! And Sakura-kun, why are you looking at me so accusingly?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Even though it's a super luxurious menu, I made it so that even if you eat all of it, it won't go over 100 kilocalories... *honk*, *sniffle*.」

name: Misa
message: 「I would be delighted to partake, Pasta!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Talk about a fast change of heart!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It really is a luxurious meal. But...」

name: Pasta
message: 「I'll keep bringing more out, nya, so you guys just sit and wait, nya. You can go ahead and start eating first, nya.」

name: Shio
message: 「No, such is my code of etiquette. First, those of higher standing must partake.」

name: Pasta
message: 「...Shaddup, pipsqueak, nya. I wasn't talking to you, nya...」

name: Shio
message: 「Huh? J-Just now, did I not hear a vaguely malicious voice...」

name: Pasta
message: 「You're hearing things, nya. Pay it no mind, nya.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll go help serve the food.」

name: Misa
message: 「If Sakura-kun is doing it, then I will too! It's a contest!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, wouldn't having too many people go actually make things less efficient?」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph, I was just saying that. I was only testing you. I'll wait quietly!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, I'll be right back.」

name: Synn
message: 「Pasta, I'll help carry--huh?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyapupu, nyapupupupu.」
He must be happy everyone's going to eat his cooking. I totally get that feeling.

name: Pasta
message: 「Damn rotten Student Council, how shall I cook you up... nyaffuffu.」
Huh? Isn't the cooking already done?
Besides, that laugh is just like Auntie Shinagawa's when she thinks she's doing something good, even though she's actually plotting something wicked...?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sparkle, sparkle~\s07 The piping-hot dishes are shining!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I was expecting the punchline to be cat food or something, but what is this? It actually looks seriously delicious.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I want to eat it, but could this food possibly...」

name: Ria
message: 「It's suspicious. Is this really only 100 kilocalories?」

name: Shio
message: 「In my humble estimation, the calories here reach at least as high as the eighth station of Mount Fuji.」

name: Misa
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Shio
message: 「A-Elder Sister, get ahold of yourself!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, there's still more coming out, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If we don't polish these off and clear them away fast, the plates won't even fit on the table.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even our Treasurer says something smart every once in a while~」
Near the kitchen--

name: Pasta
message: 「Here, carry this out, nya. Pasta will be in the back sharpening the meat cleaver and preparing dessert, nya.」
That's strange... Why would they have a blade like that for dessert?

name: Sally
message: 「Sniff, sniff, sniff! Something smells really good over here~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey there, Sally-chan.」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, it's Prez! Hiya~」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa, whoa, what's that? It looks delicious. I wanna eat it, I wanna eat it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, food always tastes better when you eat with a big group. Sally-chan, over at that table--」

name: Sally
message: 「Yahoo~! Thanks for the food~! Chomp!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, wait! It's bad manners to sneak bites before we start!」

name: Sally
message: 「Mmph!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Thud, spin~\s07 Tingle-tingle-tingle-tingle-tingle-tingle...」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sally-chan collapsed and she's convulsing!? Don't tell me this food is--」

name: Synn
message: 「This is bad. Everyone's in danger!!」

name: Ria
message: 「It doesn't appear to be lethal.」

name: Misa
message: 「In other words, they might have intended to paralyze us and have their way with us...」

name: Shio
message: 「It seems this humble one made the right choice by minding my manners!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aah, uuuh, aah, I'm all numb and can't move...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is the pufferfish poison Jeeves told me about. To cure it, you have to take a sand bath. How exciting...」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah!? Was I too late!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, this is your chance, Master Synn! Now's the time if you wanna play some naughty tricks on Soba and the angel!」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I'd ever do that!」

name: Pasta
message: 「T-That stuffed toy thinks up things even more wicked than a demon, nya...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Wait, what's going on, nya!? Only two of them went down, nya--has Pasta's grand scheme been foiled, nya!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Pasta-san! This goes way too far for a prank. What is the meaning of this!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Shut up, nya! You guys are in my way, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「I'm done being the mastermind, nya! From here on, it's time for brute force, nya!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh... I can't forgive you for this, Pasta」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sakura-kun is actually getting mad for once?」

name: Synn
message: 「It looks so delicious, yet it's poisoned? We can't even eat it? Anyone who wastes food deserves punishment!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, so that's what you're mad about」
